title: AI Pact Final
summary: The AI Pact Final outlines the agreed principles for responsible AI development and deployment. It sets standards for transparency, safety, and ethical use while encouraging collaboration among stakeholders.

title: Guidelines on prohibited artificial intelligence (AI) practices
summary: This policy lists specific AI activities that are forbidden, such as using AI to deceive people, manipulate opinions, or cause harm. It explains why these practices are disallowed and urges developers to follow responsible AI standards instead.

title: Guidelines on AI System Definition
